name: Medved'
source: The age and true origin of the character are unknown. Like other animals, the Bear mask is seemingly devoid of facial expressions and looks more like an element of a carnival costume than a real animal face. Through the eye slots on the Bear's mask, only unshakable blackness is visible, which makes it impossible to make out the color of the beast's eyes or even make sure they are there. Another striking feature of the Bear is its curved mouth with human teeth and gums. The corners of the Bear's "eyes" are turned down, which gives it a melancholic, slightly dull appearance, although the "eyes" may round out if it stops being sleepy. The bear has a plump belly, which indicates excess weight, and a bandaged left arm, which, according to him, "hurts." The bear is dressed in a wool jumpsuit without buttons, shod in felt boots and wears one mitten on his right hand.
